method: anchors identified by eye on own 1:1/2x tick-ruled crops; final line centers refined by column-ink profile inside eye-designated windows spanning only the read segment; identity and acceptance decided by eye from printed address runs and labels

controls.notes: The large remeasure deltas record first-pass display-parallax eye estimates (worst: sheet 10 east face first placed at the gallery dashed edge region ~4530); escalation diagnosis: rendering parallax plus one gallery-edge/facade confusion, both resolved by profile-confirmed tick-relative reads re-verified on the annotated evidence crops; width and shift checks close (see below). Cross-plate x-shifts: -17.0 (west) and -8.3 (east); with Ave D's -32.1/-18.8 this pair shows the largest internal shift spread of my four seams (24 px), consistent with looser residential drafting on sheet 12 and sheet 10's narrow tendency; recorded for the solve, not reconciled.
